title: Chapter 141
text:
Zhang Wei was wearing his Battler armor, standing in front of the assault boat as a shield. Lambert was shooting with his sniper rifle. There were not only four people in Zhang Wei's team on the assault boat (Lin Yao did not participate in the battle), but there were also more than ten elite soldiers.

The assault boat broke through the waves, passed through the rain of bullets, and crashed into the barge. The assault team jumped onto the deck and started a fierce battle with the Germinal soldiers.

There were two tactical objectives for the assault force. One was to kill and injure the people on the barge and blow up the ground vehicles that were parked there. The second was to kill the commander of the command ship. As the cooperation with Hesla did not arrive on time, the assault force was in a bad situation and was caught in a tough battle.

The Germinal Organization's connection was affected, and the progress was slowed down. The Germinal Organization's executive officers were deployed to defend against the assault team from Stardragon.

Zhang Wei's team was fighting hard on the barge. Suddenly, a ghost-like gust of wind hit them. They were alerted and quickly dodged, but they were still hit by the shockwave. They felt a sharp pain in their heads and felt dizzy. They gritted their teeth and looked in the direction of the enemy. It was Hella, whom they had fought before.

Hella's expression was cold. She still remembered this Stardragon person that she had fought before. She had suffered a small loss last time, so her killing intent was even stronger now. Her hands lit up with a gray light, like a strange fog that could attract the gaze of others. It was growing bigger and bigger, and one could imagine how terrifying the next attack would be.

Hou Yue's face was in pain. He raised his guns and wanted to aim, but Hella just snorted softly. Her voice had the power of the dead, and Hou Yue was hit hard. Blood spurted out of his nostrils, and he could not stand still.

Hella did not even look at him. She turned to Li Ya Lin with a murderous look. This was the female agent who had used the Lightweight Mechanical Arm before. She definitely knew where Zero was!

Li Ya Lin pulled out her retractable knife and rushed toward Hella. She did not care that she would be the first to be attacked. As the pugilist in the team, she was the assaulter.

"I hope I can withstand the first attack." Li Ya Lin gritted her teeth. As long as she could withstand Hella's next attack, she was confident that she could get close to Hella and prevent her from using that kind of mental attack. Although Hella's ability was strong, she was only using it at the moment. Every attack required channeling time.

"Naive." Hila was expressionless. She flipped her palms and was about to use the highly condensed Power of the Dead to turn Li Yalin into an idiot. The next second, a huge force suddenly came from the side of her ribs, and her entire body was pushed away. She crashed into an off-road vehicle beside her, and a sharp pain came from her ribs.

Hella was in so much pain that her face turned pale. She breathed a sigh of relief, and the Power of the Dead in her hand naturally dissipated. She turned her head to look at the source of the attack in shock and anger.

He saw a truck driving on the shore, moving parallel to the fleet. From the window of the driver's seat, a sniper rifle barrel stretched out. A black-gloved hand was holding this lethal weapon, and the muzzle was smoking.

Han Xiao pulled the bolt, and a smoking shell was ejected from the gun. He sat in the driver's seat, and the smart chip in the truck started to drive automatically. It maintained a constant speed and followed the Germinal Organization fleet on the shore. When he was in the valley, he suspected that Stardragon was going easy on them. He guessed that they wanted the Germinal Organization to intercept them and delay their troops. Therefore, Han Xiao came early and drove to the riverside. His target was the Germinal Organization's executive officer.

He saw Hella at first glance, then he saw Zhang Wei and the others. He was slightly surprised. He did not expect such a coincidence. Seeing his former teammates in danger, Han Xiao took out the Red Falcon and fired a shot. Hella's protective energy was reduced by a lot, and the penetrating force was dispersed. It turned into a force that pushed her away.

[Power of the Dead]: Master of Death, Master of Souls

Potential Rating: S

Outsiders could only see the introduction of the ability. Only the user could see the specific effects and development level.

Through the 'basic knowledge' of the Esper class, which was the development of the genetic chain to strengthen the ability, more applications could be obtained.

[Vital Point Immunity]: You are immune to critical hits. The breath of death supports your life.

[Spirit Disregard]: + 20% Negative Resistance, + 30% Mental Resistance. Master of Death, fearless.

[Ignore Instant Death]: Will not receive Fatal Damage. When HP is lower than 1%, will receive a special status — Death Like the Wind, Always Accompanying You.

Han Xiao was helpless. With this pile of abilities, even if Hella wasn't tanky, she would still be able to take a beating. No, it shouldn't be described as being able to take a beating. She was like a cockroach that couldn't be killed. Unless one used an extremely strong burst of power to instantly kill Hella … Oh, I forgot, she was also immune to instant death. Oh, I'd better go wash up and sleep …

"As expected of a future Big Boss. The number of talents he has is almost more than Bennett's. He's only one Lucky Halo away from becoming a main character."

Han Xiao shook his head. The first person he encountered was Hella, who was the most difficult person to deal with. However, Zhang Wei's team was in danger. Since he had the ability to help, he naturally wouldn't just stand by and watch. After all, they had fought side by side before.

While Hella was being obstructed, Li Yalin took advantage of the opportunity and slashed down. Hella endured the pain and retreated. Her wound healed at a speed visible to the naked eye. She was very angry at Han Xiao for sneaking up on her, but she was on the boat and couldn't deal with the sniper on the shore. Speed wasn't her forte, so she could only use the vehicle as a shield.

However, Li Yalin, Zhang Wei, and the others found an opportunity and continued to fight with her. They forced Hella to move, exposing her to Han Xiao's shooting range.

Although they didn't know who the sniper on the shore was, it was obvious that he was here to help. Thus, Zhang Wei's team took the initiative to cooperate with him.

This tactic was extremely effective, and Hila's hands and feet were tied. The sniper was extremely good at finding opportunities, and he would always be able to stop her when she was about to retaliate. His cooperation with Li Yalin, Zhang Wei, and the others was perfect, and Hila realized that she did not have any ability to retaliate. She could only keep dodging in frustration.

However, in the eyes of Zhang Wei and the others, it was a different scene. Originally, the team of four could form a tactical system, but Hou Yue was seriously injured and lost his combat power, causing a gap in their cooperation. However, the sniper filled the gap, appearing at every time when it was needed, and a sniper bullet always arrived on time.

It was as if he understood their fighting pattern very well.

Who was that person?

Li Yalin and Zhang Wei had this doubt in their minds.

On the other side, Hou Yue was dizzy and could only fight normal soldiers. Looking at the cooperation between Zhang Wei and the others and the sniper, he suddenly had a strange illusion. It was as if the sniper was the real team member and he was just an outsider.

"Hila is being held back?" Lin Yu frowned. He looked at the truck by the shore and narrowed his eyes. "Black Phantom? What is he doing here? "

The connection was coming to an end, and the estuary was not far ahead. Lin Yu really needed Hella's superpower to release group damage, so he had to release her. He ordered, "Ugar, you take care of Black Phantom."

Ugar had already boarded the barge, so he did not need to give any more orders. Hearing Han Xiao's order, he ignited a purple-black flame all over his body. Just as he was about to jump toward the truck and cause trouble for Han Xiao, he suddenly felt a Pugilist energy wave that was as strong as his. He turned around and saw a middle-aged man wearing a Stardragon agent uniform stepping onto another barge. His fist, which was wrapped in red flames, smashed into the side of an off-road vehicle that was parked on the deck.

The vehicle immediately deflated and flew out like a cannonball. It knocked over a dozen Germinal Organization soldiers and two other vehicles along the way and flew off the barge together.
